subject.title: [Security] Missing complexity validation and rate limiting on log query filters

question: Does any supported ACP or gateway ingress allow an untrusted client to submit structured historical-log filters beyond the scalar session ID/key replay lookups on current main?
rationale: The named implementation contradicts the report, but protected security triage cannot safely infer that no alternate route exists or that every ACP caller is trusted.

options.title: Confirm scalar-only ingress
options.body: Document that current ACP history replay accepts only bounded scalar selectors and close this report as not reproducible against current main.

options.title: Identify the concrete route
options.body: Keep the issue open with the exact endpoint, request schema, caller privileges, and reproducible expensive query before selecting controls.
